dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave curvature on the trailing edge, following a falcate spline from the apex to the posterior insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Small-radius rounded apex, forming the highest morphological point where the leading and trailing edges converge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep posterior-sloping angle of approximately 50-60 degrees relative to the longitudinal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.7:1, with the horizontal base width of the visible fin structure exceeding its vertical height from the dorsal ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small distinct notch/depigmentation on the upper trailing edge of the dorsal fin; multiple scattered small, circular white spots across the lateral skin surface.
